boats.name: The Keeper's Skiff
boats.desc: A patched rowing skiff with a lantern post at the stern and a scrap of sail. It was the last keeper's.

boats.name: The Puffin
boats.desc: A stout gaff sloop with tanbark sails. She lay forty years on a bar in the Reed Maze with a moorhen in her cockpit, and does not seem to have minded.
